stories.title: Cleo and the Apology With a But
stories.outro: See you next time in Sunny Meadow!
stories.moral: A helpful apology owns the mistake and helps repair the harm.
moralRhyme: Own the bump and help repair,
Show your friend you really care!

youtube.title: Cleo and the Apology With a But | Sunny Meadow
youtube.description: Cleo's grand spinning bow scattered Fiona's petal picture. Yellow petals flew across the garden path. A gentle friendship story. A helpful apology owns the mistake and helps repair the harm. #SunnyMeadow #DreamyDiscoveries

lines.text: Cleo's grand spinning bow scattered Fiona's petal picture.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Yellow petals flew across the garden path.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Ta-da! Oh. That was not my planned ending.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: My flower picture was nearly finished.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Cleo had wanted to make Fiona laugh.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Now Fiona crouched beside the scattered yellow petals.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Perhaps it looks like a very windy sunflower?
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: I was making a flower with all its petals.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Cleo picked a petal from her own tail.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Fiona straightened the picture's bent little stem.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Sorry, but you put it beside my dancing spot.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: I was working here before you started spinning.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Cleo opened her mouth for another quick excuse.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Then she saw Fiona sorting the scattered pieces.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I did not notice how close I stood.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: You could have looked before making a big spin.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Will a joke repair Fiona's petal picture?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Cleo set the rescued petal beside Fiona's paw.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Her fancy bow no longer felt very important.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I knocked your picture apart. I am sorry.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: I worked a long time arranging those colors.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Cleo sat down away from the remaining petals.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: She kept her tail still behind her paws.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Would you like help putting the picture back?
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Yes. Please gather the yellow petals from the path.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Cleo collected the petals one at a time.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: She placed them beside Fiona without guessing positions.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I found two near the garden gate.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Those small ones belong at the flower's middle.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Cleo reached for a large bright yellow petal.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Its edge had folded beneath her dancing paw.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: This one is bent. I cannot make it flat.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Leave it here. I will choose what to do.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Fiona studied the bent petal beside the straight ones.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Cleo waited instead of making another flower joke.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Would it help if I found a different petal?
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Please find one about the same size.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: What can Cleo offer to do?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Cleo searched beneath the nearby garden flowers.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: She picked up a fallen petal from the grass.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: This one fell already, and its edge is smooth.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: That looks just right for the missing place.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Fiona fitted the new petal around the flower's middle.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Cleo held the little stem while Fiona adjusted it.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Tell me when to let go of the stem.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Now, please. The flower can stay together again.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: They sat back from the repaired petal picture.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: One yellow petal remained beside Cleo's paw.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: It still looks a little different from before.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Yes. I am glad you helped me repair it.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Cleo looked at an empty patch farther down the path.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: She pointed before trying another little performance.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Is that clear spot far enough for a bow?
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Yes. A small bow would be fine over there.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Cleo bowed with both feet firmly on the ground.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Fiona smiled beside her carefully repaired flower.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: My tail would like to apologize separately.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Tell it the flower accepts absolutely no more dancing.
lines.speaker: friend
